title: The City That Knew Nobody

voiceProfile.narrator: Third-person close focus on Tanmay Bose
voiceProfile.tense: Present tense for sensory urban scenes, past tense for Bankura memories
voiceProfile.narratorDistance: Close interiority with wide lens on the city's mechanics

characters.name: Tanmay Bose
characters.description: Junior architect from Bankura, West Bengal. Quiet, watchful, carrying an oversized black drafting tube and a worn leather wallet.
characters.internalConflict: Feels swallowed by Bombay's colossal indifference while simultaneously intoxicated by the freedom of being an anonymous stranger.

characters.name: Santosh Kaka
characters.description: Cutting-chai vendor near Dadar flower market. Has stood on the same three square feet of pavement for thirty-five years.
characters.significance: The solitary human tether in an overwhelming metropolis; offers silent acknowledgment without needing names.

characters.name: Imran & Ketan
characters.description: Call-center supervisor and junior accountant sharing a 1BHK in Goregaon East.
characters.significance: Represents the transient, functional solidarity of the millions of young migrants keeping Bombay alive.

motifs: The heavy black drafting tube slung across the back like a rifle
The 8:42 AM slow local from Goregaon with rain whipping through open doors
The smell of wet marigolds at Dadar market mixed with diesel soot
The leaking blue plastic bucket catching drops from the bedroom asbestos roof
The realization that the city's indifference is its greatest gift
